drills.name: PURE — the oracle refuses every unmatched axis BY ITS NAME, a broken comparator, a declaration made after what it is read against, each of the four canon refuses, both directions of the result/continuity mix, an incomplete or over-claimed matrix, a knockout that activated something and an installation axis read through the posture — and accepts the clean shapes

SEAM — three registered contracts carry the law on the wire: eight per-axis equality rules each comparing its own axis, a separate-roots rule, an admissible-basis enum that cannot NAME any of the four canon refuses, four never-clauses and the installation instrument pinned as consts, and a system_binding shaped as the seam's own derived object rather than one a caller could author

SOURCE — the composition stays on the application side of the layer law and the Hypervisor evaluation plane references none of it, the knockouts run on a lane that plane already admits, canon states the positive control, the owner-read installation and evaluation-is-never-activation, and posture() still does not read installation_ref — the premise clause 8 rests on
BINDING — the gate is floored with an existing source and CI-bound, every clause is executed or named with an owner, and the twelve clauses are present
VERDICT — a table missing eleven of its twelve rows is a FAIL, not a pass
VERDICT — twelve green rows with no absence is a PASS
VERDICT — one named absence is a NAMED FAILURE, never a pass
VERDICT — a gate that reports success without evidence is fabricated, not green

knockouts.detail: a non-caretaker participant's exit returned null, moving nothing
the fork still names its parent artifact (true) and its posture is unchanged (forked), so ancestry is a naming relation with no liveness edge
the owner served it before (true) and does not after (false); the posture read quarantined both times, which is why this axis is read from the owner
the delegation is served (true); installing into the deleted automation is refused as lineage_installation_unbound
the plane lowers a judgment to invalid on evaluator_not_active (true) and on nondeterminism_undeclared (true) — two independent mechanisms
a sealed-lane result with no exposure left is BLOCKED against the ledger head (true), and the block is receipted rather than asserted (true)
the pairing reads back at the same head and the same bytes after a restart (true)

absences.what: FIVE AXES CANON NAMES CANNOT BE PERFORMED HERE, each for a measured reason and none for want of effort: the communication-edge knockout has no object to remove (no edge, channel or message-graph record exists anywhere; `coordination_topology` is a two-member admission-mode enum, not a graph); the role knockout has no RoleTopology record although `ContextCell.role` exists, and the composer refuses a topology-bound cell BY NAME rather than trusting one; lease EXPIRY has no writer at all (`expired` appears only in a terminal-status set and the daemon evaluates no TTL, which two independent non-claims already state) so only revocation is executable; and disclosure overhead and verification overhead have no measure — `verification_cost_class` on a suite revision is its author's declaration, not a measurement
absences.owner: M04.12's communication-edge and role-topology objects, M04.11's lease expiry, and a disclosure/verification cost measure with no owner today (owner question, R-222)
